keeper-hd-tippen-over-de-lat.uitleg: The coach kicks or throws a high ball that would drop just under the bar. The keeper steps back, takes off and tips the ball over the bar with a straight arm. Then back to their spot for the next ball.
keeper-hd-tippen-over-de-lat.organisatie: Keeper in goal, coach at 10 m with a few balls. Balls that drop just under the bar, first central and then slightly to the side.
coachpunten: Step back first, then take off (don't fall backwards)
Tip with a straight arm and open hand, guiding the ball over the bar
Keep your eyes on the ball until it's over the bar

makkelijker: The keeper starts 1 m off the line
moeilijker: The keeper starts further off the line (3 m)
Volleys from the hands
Alternate catching and tipping: the coach calls which
A low ball into the corner straight after the tip

keeper-cv-hordes-hoge-bal-hoge-duik.naam: Hurdles, high ball and high dive
keeper-cv-hordes-hoge-bal-hoge-duik.uitleg: Over three low hurdles to the goal, catch a high ball there at full stretch in the air and throw it back. Straight after, the coach throws high into the other corner: take off and make a high dive.
keeper-cv-hordes-hoge-bal-hoge-duik.organisatie: Three 30 cm hurdles beside the goal. Coach at 9 m. Each set goes the other way.
coachpunten: Over the hurdles: knees high, short ground contact
High ball: take off from one foot, catch at the highest point
High dive: a small step towards the ball first, then take off from the leg on the ball side

makkelijker: High dive onto a crash mat
moeilijker: Sideways over the hurdles
High ball with an opponent jumping with you
After the high dive, one more low ball into the same corner

keeper-cv-hoog-dan-laag.naam: High dive, get up and low in the other corner
keeper-cv-hoog-dan-laag.uitleg: The coach throws high into one corner: high dive and catch. The keeper gets straight up, puts the ball down and gets set again. The second ball goes low into the other corner.
keeper-cv-hoog-dan-laag.organisatie: Keeper in goal, coach at 9 m with two balls. Alternate starting left and right. 30 seconds' rest after each set.
coachpunten: Get up through your knees and straight back to the middle
Get set in the ready position first, then react to the second ball
Low: dive forwards to the ball, don't fall away sideways

makkelijker: More time between the two balls
High ball at chest height (no dive)
moeilijker: The second ball comes while the keeper is still getting up
Third ball straight at the keeper
Shoot instead of throwing

onderdelen: Get up and put the ball down
Low dive in the other corner

keeper-cv-tip-en-lage-bal.naam: Tip over the bar, then a low ball
keeper-cv-tip-en-lage-bal.uitleg: The coach kicks a high ball that drops just under the bar: the keeper steps back and tips it over. They recover straight away, get set again and the coach shoots the second ball low into the corner.
keeper-cv-tip-en-lage-bal.organisatie: Keeper in goal, coach at 10 m with two balls. About 2 seconds between the two balls.
coachpunten: Tipping: step back first, then take off with a straight arm
After landing, step forward straight away into the ready position
Low ball: dive forwards, towards the ball

makkelijker: More time for the second ball
Catch the high ball instead of tipping it
moeilijker: The second ball comes straight after landing
Tip round the post, then low into the other corner
Third ball: clear a back pass

keeper-hd-hordes-zijwaarts.naam: Sideways hurdles and a high dive
keeper-hd-hordes-zijwaarts.uitleg: The keeper jumps sideways over three low hurdles beside the goal, facing the pitch. After the last hurdle they take one more step and dive on to the same side, to a high shot from the coach. Catch, get up, ball back and the next set to the other side.
keeper-hd-hordes-zijwaarts.organisatie: Three 30 cm hurdles in a row beside the goal, 1 m apart, 2 m in front of the goal line. Coach with balls at 9–10 m. Alternate sides.
coachpunten: Sideways over the hurdles: short ground contact, knees high, shoulders towards the pitch
Straight into the ready position after the last hurdle: ready to take off
Take off from the leg on the ball side, hands in front of the ball

moeilijker: Higher hurdles
The coach only picks the corner after the last hurdle
After the high dive, one more low ball into the other corner

keeper-hd-horde-volley-hoog.naam: Over the hurdle and back: volley and high shot
keeper-hd-horde-volley-hoog.uitleg: The keeper stands in the middle of the goal. They jump sideways over a hurdle to one side and straight back, then face a volley at the body: catch and throw it back. Then over the hurdle and back once more, followed by a high shot into that side of the goal: high dive and catch.
keeper-hd-horde-volley-hoog.organisatie: Low hurdle 1.2 m from the centre of the goal, 1.8 m in front of the goal line. Coach with balls at 9–10 m. Alternate the hurdle left and right.
coachpunten: Over the hurdle: short ground contact, knees high, shoulders towards the coach
Straight into the ready position after the hurdle: the ball comes immediately
High dive: take off from the leg on the ball side, hands behind the ball

makkelijker: Throw the volley and the high ball instead of kicking
moeilijker: Twice over and back before each ball
Higher hurdle
The coach picks the corner for the high shot at the last moment

keeper-hd-slalom-pion-duiken.naam: Slalom, touch the cone and dive
keeper-hd-slalom-pion-duiken.uitleg: The keeper slaloms through four poles in front of goal, comes into the goal and touches a cone on one side. Straight after, they dive to the other side for a high ball from the coach. Get up, ball back and then the same slalom the other way: touch the cone on that side and dive to the other side, this time low.
keeper-hd-slalom-pion-duiken.organisatie: Four poles in a row, 1.4 m apart, 4.6 m in front of the goal line. Two cones in the goal, 2.2 m off the line and 1.5 m inside each post. Coach with balls at 10 m.
coachpunten: Slalom with small steps, shoulders towards the coach
After touching the cone, get set first, then take off
High dive: take off from the leg on the ball side; low dive: fall sideways, hands first

makkelijker: No slalom: just touch and dive
moeilijker: The coach only chooses high or low after the touch
Poles closer together
Touch twice before the dive

keeper-hd-halfknie-pion-hoog.uitleg: The keeper is half-kneeling in front of goal and catches a high ball from the coach. Ball back, get up and touch a cone to their left. Then three quick steps to the right and a high dive to a ball in the right-hand corner.
keeper-hd-halfknie-pion-hoog.organisatie: Keeper half-kneeling 2 m in front of goal, cone 1 m to their left. Coach with balls at 9 m.
coachpunten: Half-kneeling: straight back, hands in front of the body, catch above your head
Get up and touch the cone in one smooth movement
Three steps, then take off from the right leg and stretch high

makkelijker: Two steps and a mid-height dive
moeilijker: Switch knees: the other knee on the ground
The coach only picks the corner after the touch
Ball high into the far corner

keeper-hd-hordes-slalom-paal.uitleg: The keeper jumps over two high hurdles, slaloms round two cones and then moves backwards, facing the pitch, to the left post. They touch the post and immediately dive high to the other side for a ball from the coach.
keeper-hd-hordes-slalom-paal.organisatie: Course in front of the left side of the goal: two 45 cm hurdles, with two cones behind them. Coach with balls at 9 m, straight in front of goal.
coachpunten: Over the hurdles: knees high, drive your arms
Backwards to the post: small steps, keep watching the coach
After touching the post, get set first, then take off powerfully

moeilijker: Three hurdles
Ball into the far corner
The coach throws while the keeper is touching the post

keeper-hd-kleur-powerduik.naam: Call a colour and power dive
keeper-hd-kleur-powerduik.uitleg: Three coloured disc cones lie in front of goal. The coach calls a colour; the keeper sprints to that disc cone, takes off powerfully and dives high to a ball from the coach. The coach calls the next colour while the keeper is still on the ground: up and straight off again. Three in a row.
keeper-hd-kleur-powerduik.organisatie: Red on the left, blue on the right and yellow in the middle, about 2.5 m in front of goal. Coach with balls at 10 m.
coachpunten: At the disc cone: short last step, then a powerful take-off
Stretch high and far, hands behind the ball
Secure the ball as you land, then get up quickly through your knees

moeilijker: Four colours
The coach calls two colours in a row
Ball just out of reach: tip instead of catching

keeper-hd-buiklig-verre-paal.naam: Up from lying on your front and the far post
keeper-hd-buiklig-verre-paal.uitleg: The keeper lies on their front by the left post, head towards the pitch. On a signal they get up as fast as they can, sprint to the far post and attack a high ball from the coach there: catch it at full stretch in the air. Then from the other post: on your front again, up and across to the other side, this time with a high dive.
keeper-hd-buiklig-verre-paal.organisatie: Keeper lying on their front by the post. Coach with balls at 9 m, straight in front of goal; they throw high to the far post as soon as the keeper gets up.
coachpunten: Getting up: hands under your shoulders, up in one movement
Sprint with your eyes on the ball
Attack the high ball: take off from one foot, other knee up, catch at the highest point

makkelijker: Ball lower and closer to the keeper
moeilijker: The signal is a colour or number
Start lying on your back
Ball just under the bar: tip it
